svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Tube: cut 260 mm of 26 x 2.5 mm steel tube; deburr; plug the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: ends with push-in caps after painting.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: At mid-length drill 16 mm straight through both walls, square

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: to the tube, so the upper rod passes through.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Seat disc: 30 mm diameter, 5 mm thick, with a 20 mm recess

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 3 mm deep in its top face.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: push the upper rod up through the tube until its top end is

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: flush with the top of the tube, the tube square to the rod.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Weld the tube to the rod all round where the rod comes out, top

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and bottom (or have a shop do it). Weld the disc centred on the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: rod top. Paint, then bond the 20 mm bubble level in the recess.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the level reads centred when the rod hangs plumb; the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: handle is square to the rod within 1 degree.
